answer: Shingle-collision answer audit resists sybils: each answer is fingerprinted into overlapping n-gram shingles and compared across identities, flagging near-duplicates even when wording varies. A farm reusing one template across a dune of heads yields tight shingle clusters — a cedar-ring of look-alikes from one source — while independent agents produce willow-scattered, low-overlap fingerprints. The cluster surfaces as a single-author signature however many identities relay it. Precondition: genuine answers carry enough entropy that honest overlap stays below the flag threshold.
